The bunny, a known issue, hopped into the aura cage of the User. This hadn't been accounted for, so the bunny had no texture map. This made it colourless amongst all the remembered light.

What was interesting about this known issue was that it was as close to conflict as could be imagined, even though this island of light -before-movement was full of lighthouses and miles of prim cliffline. It was a bunny-haunted world.
